quotes.text: DiagBench integrates data from four distinct sources: MIMIC-IV [ 18 ] , PMC-OA case reports [ 19 ]

parsed.rationale: The four source datasets are named with citations and access links, and PMC-OA cases are bounded by a publication date. No MIMIC-IV version or snapshot is given and no route from a benchmark case back to its source record is documented, so 1.
